evidence.title: Restore deep authorized Command Incident from Investigate across Work Queue pagination
evidence.goal: Complete CAP-CMD-106 Class-0 Incident → Investigate → Incident return when the original Incident is not on the first 50 rows, using the existing owner-filtered Command Work Queue and its revision-bound cursor, never a new permission or separate Incident engine.
outputs: Original selected Incident returns correctly even if on page three; source-authorized same-origin Work Queue renders correct page, HTML selection, prev/next cursors.
Off-page selection without restore stays denied, API JSON unchanged, invalid restore fails before owner, revocation gives 404 with no leak.
acceptance_tests: Normal no-restore selection of off-page Incident remains 404 (prior explicit cursor invariant).
HTML read-only restore deep Incident #100 succeeds only if the current Command Owner authorizes it after all 124 in-scope ACL decisions; returns its correct real page and cursor.
Revoking target access before return fails generic 404 and no stale content.
Restore in JSON or with Task, extra query keys, cursor or malformed token rejects 400 before owner lookup.
Original Case/source roundtrip points to single canonical relative Command route using restore=1 and still independently authorizes Incident.
Full Work Queue/Timeline/Command-investigate-host Go/race/vet and global engineering checks pass on exact head SHA.

rules: Strict tenant isolation and permission checking
